# RingoMusic

> RingoMusic is a free, open-source Apple Music client for Linux with a native GNOME look. It is written in Rust with GTK 4 and libadwaita. An Apple Music subscription is required. RingoMusic is not affiliated with Apple Inc.

Key facts:

- Platform: Linux, x86_64 only. No aarch64 support (no official Widevine module for aarch64 Linux).
- Minimum distributions: Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, the two supported Fedora releases (GTK 4.18, libadwaita 1.7, glibc 2.41 or newer).
- Packages: .deb, .rpm, Flatpak bundle, AppImage, tarball on GitHub Releases; AUR package `ringomusic-bin`.
- Audio quality: AAC 256 kbps. No lossless, no Dolby Atmos.
- No download, export, or recording of audio. This rule is permanent.
- Privacy: RingoMusic never reads or stores Apple ID credentials. No telemetry.
- Desktop integration: MPRIS (media keys, GNOME Shell media controls), keyboard shortcuts, adaptive layout down to 360 px.
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later. App ID: io.github.MedaiP90.RingoMusic.
